206-339-677-8249.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Jegantha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1339-2511-7920.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-2511-7920.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Tresserhorn's Lord triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

628-4247-5007.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Morselhoarder.
When Morselhoarder dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability
Activate Morselhoarder by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, adding one mana of any color
Repeat.
628-4247-5007.notes: The remaining -1/-1 counter can be removed each loop to gain infinite colored mana.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3899-4019-6972.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Vigean Graftmage.
When Vigean Graftmage dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

3629-6734-8089.easyPrerequisites:
Cloudsteel Kirin attached to a creature you control.
Your life total is even.
3629-6734-8089.description:
Activate Shadowcloak Vampire by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

889-1618-2440-7377.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Deekah
889-1618-2440-7377.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Festering March.
Festering March triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Deekah triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Festering March.
Repeat.
889-1618-2440-7377.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Deekah. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

772-891-2438.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Shade's Form triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Shade's Form from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1796-1824-2530-7360.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation, nor are currently venturing in it.
1796-1824-2530-7360.description:
Cast Acererak by paying {B}.
God-Pharaoh's Faithful triggers, causing you to gain life.
When Acererak enters, its first ability and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

2281-4050-6132.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Saffi triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1385-3967-4681-5170.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Zulaport Cutthroat triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Zulaport Cutthroat trigger.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

3685-5226-6747.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven artifacts.
3685-5226-6747.description:
Cast Spine of Ish Sah by paying {0} due to Sami.
When Spine of Ish Sah enters, its first ability triggers, targeting either a permanent an opponent controls or itself if an opponent doesn't control a targetable permanent.
Holding priority, activate Lithatog by sacrificing Spine of Ish Sah.
If you targeted Spine of Ish Sah in step 2, the ability will fizzle due to having no legal target.
Spine of Ish Sah's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Lithatog ability from step 3.
Resolve the Spine of Ish Sah trigger from step 2, if applicable.
Repeat from step 1.

141-4050-6819.description:
Cast Vincent's Limit Break by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Vincent's Limit Break, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Vincent's Limit Break.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

198-1978-3088.description:
Animate Empowered Autogenerator using Xenic Poltergeist.
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding {1} for each charge counter on it.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Repeat from step 2.
198-1978-3088.notes: The combo assumes Empowered Autogenerator has no charge counters on it when you start. If it has charge counters, the mana cost is reduced by {1}.

1020-2866-3375-6518.description:
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {0}.
When Scrap Trawler enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Scrap Trawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
When Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Myr Retriever and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1168-1479-5700-5701-6763.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1168-1479-5700-5701-6763.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Toggo trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Toggo trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Toggo triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Toggo trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Toggo triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

2143-6441.description:
Activate Spawnsire of Ulamog by paying {4}, creating four 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

2034-4871-5626-6415.description:
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing another creature and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning Wriggling Grub from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wriggling Grub.
When Wriggling Grub dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Wriggling Grub trigger, creating two 1/1 Worm creature tokens.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Ashnod's Altar ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

5137-5457-5963.notablePrerequisites: Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
5137-5457-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Selvala's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Marvin using Morphling's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

225-1170-1645-2499-5954.notablePrerequisites: Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-1170-1645-2499-5954.description:
Cast Crown of Flames by paying {R}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere land tokens enter the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers that many times.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping an Everywhere token.
Repeat from step 5 for the remaining trigger.
Resolve the Crown of Flames spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Crown of Flames by paying {R}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1309-2061-2104.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Temporal Manipulation each turn.
1309-2061-2104.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Salvager of Secrets.
When the Salvager of Secrets token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

501-586-5147-5258-5618.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1323-2872-3143-4762.notablePrerequisites:
Experiment Kraj and Xavier Sal do not have summoning sickness.
Devoted Druid and Clever Conjurer each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
You control at least one creature token.
1323-2872-3143-4762.description:
Activate Experiment Kraj using Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Xavier Sal's first ability by tapping it and removing a -1/-1 counter from Experiment Kraj, creating a copy of any creature token you control.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Clever Conjurer's ability by tapping it, untapping Xavier Sal.
Repeat.

3000-4268-5670.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
3000-4268-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

2634-4191-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}.
2634-4191-4276.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Turnabout.
Cast Rootha by paying {0} due to Aluren.
Resolve the copy of Turnabout, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Repeat from step 3.

643-2353-2395-4508.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
643-2353-2395-4508.description:
Draw a card.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcom triggers, creating a Treasure token.
The Treasure enters the battlefield, triggering Quicksmith Genius, causing you to loot.
Repeat from step 2.
